queer_characters.name: Jamie Gangel
queer_characters.notes: Introverted gay teen whose romantic feelings for neighbor Ste form the film's affirming core, culminating in a public dance embraced by his mother.

queer_characters.name: Ste Pearce
queer_characters.notes: Jamie's classmate who, despite initial hesitation and abuse at home, gradually accepts his relationship with Jamie in an affirming arc.
